newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES CLOSE HIGHER IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES CLOSE HIGHER IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.

text.p: Six stocks rose, six fell and eight were flat in 6.6-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Tuesday with the WIG 20 index up 1.7 percent to 1,473.3 points.
In comparison with their main-market fixing 17 stocks rose and three were flat.
Trade in BIG was suspended on Tuesday and the remaining nine stocks did not trade.
NFI units rose 1.2 percent to 122.5 zlotys in a 12.4-million-zloty turnover.
The National Investment Fund NFI index rose 1.5 percent to 125.9 points in 1.8-million-zloty trade.
